guide.summary: English 'can' and 'will' split three ways. 会 is know-how you learned, and also 'will' for a prediction. 能 is being able in practice: the situation, your body or your capacity lets it happen, often with an amount. 可以 is 'it is allowed' or 'that option is open'. Ask which meaning of 'can' you intend: learned it, able to right now, or allowed to.

subs.label: 会: learned skill
subs.focus: Someone has or has not learned how to do something (language, driving, swimming, cooking), no amount, no circumstance: choose 会 / 不会. Classic error: 可以 or 能 for 'know how to'. Add 学过, 没学过 or 从小 so that 能 is not also acceptable.

subs.label: 会: prediction 'will'
subs.focus: A prediction of what will or will not happen (weather, consequence, reaction, 如果 ...): choose 会 / 不会, not 能 or 可以. Classic errors: 明天可以下雨, and 不能 meant as 'won't'. The cue must be an unmistakable prediction, not ability or permission.

subs.label: 会 ... 的: assurance
subs.focus: A promise or reassurance with 会 ... 的 (我会给你打电话的, 他不会忘的). Decide that the modal is 会 (not 能 / 可以), that 的 closes the sentence, and that no 了 is added. Classic errors: 的 placed right after 会, or 会 dropped while 的 is kept.

subs.label: 能: able under the circumstances
subs.focus: The skill is assumed; the situation, time, health or equipment decides whether it is possible now: choose 能 / 不能, not 会 / 不会. Classic error: 我喝酒了，不会开车. Include recovered ability (病好了，能上班了) and 会 ... 但是今天不能. The sentence must state the circumstance.

subs.label: 能 + amount reached
subs.focus: Ability measured by an amount, distance, speed or duration (一顿能吃三碗, 一分钟能打一百个字, 能游一千米): choose 能, not 会 or 可以. Classic error: 他会吃三碗米饭 for 'he can eat three bowls'. Every item needs an explicit number and measure after the verb.

subs.label: 可以: allowed / an open option
subs.focus: Permission (这儿可以拍照) and offering an option (你可以坐地铁去): choose 可以 over 会. Classic error: 我会用你的手机吗 for 'may I?'. 能 is also correct for permission, so never offer 能 as a wrong option there; only in a 'you could ...' suggestion is 可以 the sole natural choice.

subs.label: 不会 / 不能 / 不可以, answering 'may I?'
subs.focus: Pick the negative: 不会 = not learned / won't happen; 不能 = unable or not allowed; 不可以 = not allowed only. Classic errors: 我明天不可以来 for 'can't make it', 不会 for a prohibition. Answers to 可以 ... 吗: 可以 / 行, or 不行 / 不能. Never contrast 不能 with 不可以 in a prohibition.

subs.label: 很会 / 很能
subs.focus: After 很 / 真 / 挺 / 特别: 很会 + verb = skilful (很会做饭, 很会说话); 很能 + verb = large capacity (很能吃, 很能睡). Choose 会 or 能 from the meaning and reject 可以. Classic errors: 很可以做饭, and 很会吃 meant as 'eats a lot'. Context must fix skill versus amount.

rules.rule: For something you learned how to do, use 会. The negative 不会 means you never learned it.

examples.py: wǒ huì kāi chē
examples.en: I can drive. (I know how)

examples.py: tā huì shuō yī diǎn r zhōng wén
examples.en: She can speak a little Chinese.

examples.py: wǒ méi xué guò bù huì yóu yǒng
examples.en: I never learned, so I can't swim.

examples.py: nǐ huì bù huì yòng kuài zi
examples.en: Do you know how to use chopsticks?

rules.note: In everyday speech 能 also turns up with languages (你能说中文吗？ 'are you able to speak Chinese?'), but for plain know-how 会 is the standard choice and the one to produce. 可以 never means 'know how to'.

rules.rule: For a prediction, 'will' or 'is likely to', use 会; 'won't' is 不会. This 会 has nothing to do with skill.

examples.py: míng tiān huì xià yǔ
examples.en: It will rain tomorrow.

examples.py: chuān zhè me shǎo nǐ huì gǎn mào
examples.en: Dressed that lightly, you'll catch a cold.

examples.py: bié dān xīn tā bù huì shēng qì
examples.en: Don't worry, he won't be angry.

examples.zh: 如果你不去，她会很难过。
examples.py: rú guǒ nǐ bù qù tā huì hěn nán guò
examples.en: If you don't go, she'll be very upset.

rules.note: 会 predicts; it does not announce a plan. For 'I'm going to ...' as a decision, Chinese prefers 要 or 打算. 可以 cannot predict, and 不能 does not mean 'won't'.

rules.rule: To promise or reassure, wrap the prediction in 会 ... 的. 的 sits at the very end and no 了 is added.
rules.pattern: Subject + (一定) + (不) + 会 + Verb + (Object) + 的

examples.py: wǒ huì gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de
examples.en: I will call you. (I promise)

examples.py: fàng xīn ba tā yī dìng huì lái de
examples.en: Relax, he will definitely come.

examples.py: wǒ bù huì wàng jì nǐ de
examples.en: I won't forget you.

rules.note: The 的 is optional: without it the sentence is a plain prediction, with it the speaker sounds sure and reassuring. It is not the past-tense 是 ... 的.

rules.rule: When the question is whether the situation, your time or your body lets you do it, use 能. 不能 here means 'cannot manage to'.

examples.py: wǒ jīn tiān yǒu shì bù néng qù
examples.en: I'm busy today, so I can't go.

examples.py: nǐ míng tiān néng lái ma
examples.en: Can you come tomorrow?

examples.py: wǒ hē jiǔ le bù néng kāi chē
examples.en: I've been drinking, so I can't drive.

rules.note: 不会 in these sentences would say something else: 我今天不会去 means 'I won't go today' (a prediction), and 不会开车 means 'never learned to drive'.

rules.rule: You have the skill (会) but whether you can use it on this occasion, or again after getting better, is 能.

examples.py: tā de tuǐ hǎo le néng zǒu lù le
examples.en: His leg is better; he can walk again.

examples.zh: 我会游泳，但是今天感冒了，不能游。
examples.py: wǒ huì yóu yǒng dàn shì jīn tiān gǎn mào le bù néng yóu
examples.en: I can swim, but I have a cold today, so I can't.

examples.zh: 她病好了，明天能上班了。
examples.py: tā bìng hǎo le míng tiān néng shàng bān le
examples.en: She has recovered and can go to work tomorrow.

rules.note: 孩子会走路了 is correct for a baby who has just learned to walk: learned for the first time is 会, got the ability back is 能.

rules.rule: If the ability is measured by an amount, a distance, a speed or a length of time, use 能, even for a learned skill.
rules.pattern: Subject + (time span) + 能 + Verb + number + measure + (Object)

examples.py: tā yī dùn néng chī sān wǎn mǐ fàn
examples.en: He can eat three bowls of rice in one meal.

examples.zh: 她一分钟能打一百个字。
examples.py: tā yī fēn zhōng néng dǎ yī bǎi gè zì
examples.en: She can type a hundred characters a minute.

examples.py: wǒ néng yóu yī qiān mǐ
examples.en: I can swim a thousand metres.

rules.note: 会 says only that the skill exists (我会游泳); how much of it you can manage is 能. 他会吃三碗 would be heard as a prediction, 'he will eat three bowls'.

rules.rule: For 'it is allowed' or 'may I?', use 可以. Never use 会 for permission.

examples.py: wǒ kě yǐ jìn lái ma
examples.en: May I come in?

examples.py: zhè r kě yǐ pāi zhào
examples.en: You may take photos here.

examples.py: nǐ kě yǐ yòng wǒ de shǒu jī
examples.en: You can use my phone.

rules.note: 能 is just as common in permission questions (我能进来吗？) and in rules. Between 能 and 可以 for permission there is no wrong choice; the real error is 会.

rules.rule: To offer an option or say something is feasible ('you could ...', 'one way is ...'), use 可以.

examples.py: nǐ kě yǐ zuò dì tiě qù
examples.en: You could go by subway.

examples.zh: 不想做饭的话，我们可以出去吃。
examples.py: bù xiǎng zuò fàn de huà wǒ men kě yǐ chū qù chī
examples.en: If you don't feel like cooking, we could eat out.

examples.py: yǒu wèn tí kě yǐ wèn lǎo shī
examples.en: If you have questions, you can ask the teacher.

rules.note: The negative of this 'could' is not 不可以. 'It can't be done that way' is 不能 or a potential complement such as 去不了.

rules.rule: Three different 'cannot's: 不会 = haven't learned, or won't happen; 不能 = unable, or not allowed; 不可以 = not allowed, and only that.
rules.pattern: Subject + 不会 / 不能 / 不可以 + Verb

examples.py: wǒ míng tiān bù néng lái
examples.en: I can't come tomorrow.

examples.py: zhè r bù néng chōu yān
examples.en: You can't smoke here.

examples.zh: 上课的时候不可以玩手机。
examples.py: shàng kè de shí hou bù kě yǐ wán shǒu jī
examples.en: You may not play on your phone in class.

examples.py: wǒ bù huì zuò fàn
examples.en: I can't cook. (never learned)

rules.note: For a prohibition 不能 and 不可以 are both correct; 不可以 sounds a little more like a rule being laid down. For 'unable', only 不能 works: 我明天不可以来 would mean someone forbids you to come.

rules.rule: Answering 可以 ... 吗 / 能 ... 吗: yes is 可以 or 行; no is normally 不行 or 不能, usually followed by a reason.

examples.py: bù xíng zhè r yǒu rén
examples.en: No (you can't sit here), someone is sitting here.

examples.py: duì bu qǐ xiàn zài bù néng jìn qù
examples.en: Sorry, you can't go in right now.

examples.py: kě yǐ nǐ yòng ba
examples.en: Sure, go ahead and use it.

rules.note: 不可以 as a short answer is grammatical but blunt, the way a parent or a sign speaks. 不会 is never an answer to a request for permission.

rules.rule: 很会 + verb means 'really good at' (skill); 很能 + verb means 'can do a great deal of' (capacity). 可以 does not take 很 in this way.
rules.pattern: Subject + 很 / 真 / 特别 + 会 / 能 + Verb

examples.py: tā hěn huì zuò fàn
examples.en: She is really good at cooking.

examples.zh: 他很会说话，大家都喜欢他。
examples.py: tā hěn huì shuō huà dà jiā dōu xǐ huan tā
examples.en: He is good with words; everybody likes him.

examples.py: wǒ dì di hěn néng chī
examples.en: My little brother can really eat.

examples.zh: 这个孩子真能睡，睡了十二个小时。
examples.py: zhè ge hái zi zhēn néng shuì shuì le shí èr gè xiǎo shí
examples.en: This kid can really sleep; he slept twelve hours.

rules.note: 很会吃 exists too but means 'knows good food', not 'eats a lot'. 很能说 means 'talks a lot', 很会说 means 'speaks cleverly'.

right.py: wǒ xué guò wǒ huì yóu yǒng

contrasts.why: Know-how you learned is 会. 可以游泳 says swimming is allowed or is an option, not that you know how.
A prediction takes 会. 可以 is permission or an open option, and rain needs neither.

right.py: wǒ hē jiǔ le bù néng kāi chē
right.en: I've been drinking, so I can't drive.

contrasts.why: The skill is still there; the circumstance blocks it, so 不能. 不会开车 means you never learned to drive.

right.py: tā yī dùn néng chī sān wǎn mǐ fàn
right.en: He can eat three bowls of rice in one meal.

contrasts.why: A measured amount of ability takes 能. With 会 the sentence is no longer about capacity.

contrasts.wrong: 我明天有考试，不可以来。

right.py: wǒ míng tiān yǒu kǎo shì bù néng lái
right.en: I have an exam tomorrow, so I can't come.

contrasts.why: 'Can't make it' is 不能. 不可以 only means 'not permitted', as if someone had forbidden you to come.

right.zh: 我可以用一下你的笔吗？
right.py: wǒ kě yǐ yòng yī xià nǐ de bǐ ma
right.en: May I use your pen for a moment?

contrasts.why: Asking permission takes 可以 (or 能). 会 would ask whether you know how to use a pen, or whether you will.

right.py: tā de tuǐ hǎo le néng zǒu lù le
right.en: His leg is better; he can walk again.

contrasts.why: An ability you get back after injury or illness is 能. 会走路了 is for a baby who has just learned to walk.

right.en: She is really good at cooking.

contrasts.why: 'Good at' is 很会. 可以 does not combine with 很 to describe skill.

right.py: bié dān xīn wǒ huì bāng nǐ de
right.en: Don't worry, I will help you.

contrasts.why: In the assurance pattern 的 closes the whole sentence; nothing may come between 会 and the verb phrase except adverbs or a coverb phrase.

cheat: Learned how to? 会. Never learned? 不会.
Will it happen? 会 / 不会. Promising? Add 的 at the very end.
A reason in the sentence (busy, ill, drunk, recovered)? 能 / 不能.
A number or measure after the verb? 能.
Allowed, or 'you could ...'? 可以. Permission is never 会.
'Can't make it' is 不能, not 不可以. Saying no to 'may I?': 不行 or 不能.
很会 = skilful; 很能 = a lot; never 很可以 + verb.

items.q: 小王是我的同学，他___说三种语言。
items.zh: 小王是我的同学，他会说三种语言。
items.py: xiǎo wáng shì wǒ de tóng xué tā huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔ yán
items.en: Xiao Wang is my classmate; he can speak three languages.
items.why: Knowing a language is a learned skill, so 会. 可以 would say he is allowed to speak them, which is not the point.

items.q: 老师___说英语和日语。
items.zh: 老师会说英语和日语。
items.py: lǎo shī huì shuō yīng yǔ hé rì yǔ
items.en: The teacher can speak English and Japanese.
items.why: Speaking a language you have learned is 会. 可以 means permission and 要 means want or need, neither of which says the teacher knows the languages.

items.q: 我奶奶从来没学过，不___用电脑。
items.zh: 我奶奶从来没学过，不会用电脑。
items.py: wǒ nǎi nai cóng lái méi xué guò bù huì yòng diàn nǎo
items.en: My grandma has never learned; she can't use a computer.
items.why: 没学过 says she lacks the know-how, so 不会. 不可以 would mean she is forbidden to use it.

items.q: 你___开手动挡的车吗？
items.zh: 你会开手动挡的车吗？
items.py: nǐ huì kāi shǒu dòng dǎng de chē ma
items.en: Do you know how to drive a manual car?
items.why: The question is whether you have learned the skill, so 会. 可以 would ask whether you are allowed to, and 得 means must.

items.q: 我儿子才两岁，还不___自己穿衣服。
items.zh: 我儿子才两岁，还不会自己穿衣服。
items.py: wǒ ér zi cái liǎng suì hái bù huì zì jǐ chuān yī fu
items.en: My son is only two; he can't dress himself yet.
items.why: A child who has not yet learned a skill is 不会. 不可以 would mean he is not permitted to dress himself.

items.q: 她是学音乐的，___弹好几种乐器。
items.zh: 她是学音乐的，会弹好几种乐器。
items.py: tā shì xué yīn yuè de huì tán hǎo jǐ zhǒng yuè qì
items.en: She studied music; she can play several instruments.
items.why: Training in music shows learned skill, so 会. 可以 would grant permission and 要 would say she wants or needs to play.

items.q: 我在日本住了一年，已经___说一些简单的日语了。
items.zh: 我在日本住了一年，已经会说一些简单的日语了。
items.py: wǒ zài rì běn zhù le yī nián yǐ jīng huì shuō yī xiē jiǎn dān de rì yǔ le
items.en: I've lived in Japan for a year and can already say some simple Japanese.
items.why: Having picked up a skill is 会 (with 已经 ... 了 for 'now can'). 要 and 应该 express wanting or obligation, not acquired ability.

items.q: 我们公司的新同事不___用这个软件，需要有人教他。
items.zh: 我们公司的新同事不会用这个软件，需要有人教他。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī de xīn tóng shì bù huì yòng zhè ge ruǎn jiàn xū yào yǒu rén jiāo tā
items.en: The new colleague at our company doesn't know how to use this software and needs someone to teach him.
items.why: Needing to be taught means he has not learned it: 不会. 不可以 would mean he is not allowed to use it, which 需要有人教他 does not suggest.

items.q: 你___用这个打印机吗？我从来没用过。
items.zh: 你会用这个打印机吗？我从来没用过。
items.py: nǐ huì yòng zhè ge dǎ yìn jī ma wǒ cóng lái méi yòng guò
items.en: Do you know how to use this printer? I've never used it.
items.why: Asking whether someone knows how to operate something is 会. 可以 would ask whether it is permitted.

items.q: 天气预报说，明天___下雨。
items.zh: 天气预报说，明天会下雨。
items.py: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān huì xià yǔ
items.en: The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
items.why: A forecast predicts what will happen, so 会. 可以 is permission and 能 is ability; rain needs neither.

items.q: 如果你不告诉老师，他不___知道。
items.zh: 如果你不告诉老师，他不会知道。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ bù gào sù lǎo shī tā bù huì zhī dào
items.en: If you don't tell the teacher, he won't know.
items.why: A prediction that something will not happen is 不会. 不能知道 would mean he is not allowed or able to know, which is not the idea here.

items.q: 你不复习的话，考试___不及格。
items.zh: 你不复习的话，考试会不及格。
items.py: nǐ bù fù xí de huà kǎo shì huì bù jí gé
items.en: If you don't review, you'll fail the exam.
items.why: The 的话 clause sets up a consequence, and a predicted consequence takes 会. 可以 would turn failing into something permitted.

items.q: 老板看到这份报告，一定___很高兴。
items.zh: 老板看到这份报告，一定会很高兴。
items.py: lǎo bǎn kàn dào zhè fèn bào gào yī dìng huì hěn gāo xìng
items.en: When the boss sees this report, he'll surely be pleased.
items.why: 一定 plus a predicted reaction takes 会. 可以 and 能 cannot forecast a feeling.

items.q: 别担心，这次考试不___很难。
items.zh: 别担心，这次考试不会很难。
items.py: bié dān xīn zhè cì kǎo shì bù huì hěn nán
items.en: Don't worry, this exam won't be very hard.
items.why: Reassuring about what will turn out is a prediction: 不会. 不能很难 would mean it must not be hard, and 不可以 makes no sense with an exam.

items.q: 五点以后路上肯定___堵车，我们早点走吧。
items.zh: 五点以后路上肯定会堵车，我们早点走吧。
items.py: wǔ diǎn yǐ hòu lù shàng kěn dìng huì dǔ chē wǒ men zǎo diǎn zǒu ba
items.en: The roads will definitely be jammed after five; let's leave early.
items.why: 肯定 plus a forecast of traffic takes 会. 可以堵车 would say traffic jams are permitted.

items.q: 会议九点开始，我觉得经理不___迟到。
items.zh: 会议九点开始，我觉得经理不会迟到。
items.py: huì yì jiǔ diǎn kāi shǐ wǒ jué de jīng lǐ bù huì chí dào
items.en: The meeting starts at nine; I don't think the manager will be late.
items.why: 我觉得 introduces a guess about what will happen, so 不会. 不能迟到 would be an order that he must not be late.

items.q: 要是你每天都练习，你的口语一定___进步得很快。
items.zh: 要是你每天都练习，你的口语一定会进步得很快。
items.py: yào shi nǐ měi tiān dōu liàn xí nǐ de kǒu yǔ yī dìng huì jìn bù de hěn kuài
items.en: If you practise every day, your spoken Chinese will definitely improve very fast.
items.why: 要是 ... 一定 gives a predicted result, so 会. 可以 would turn the improvement into something allowed.

items.q: 如果公司不给他加薪，他可能___辞职。
items.zh: 如果公司不给他加薪，他可能会辞职。
items.py: rú guǒ gōng sī bù gěi tā jiā xīn tā kě néng huì cí zhí
items.en: If the company doesn't give him a raise, he might quit.
items.why: 可能 with a predicted action takes 会. 可以 would suggest he is allowed to quit, not that it is likely.

items.q: 你别难过，李老师不___批评你的。
items.zh: 你别难过，李老师不会批评你的。
items.py: nǐ bié nán guò lǐ lǎo shī bù huì pī píng nǐ de
items.en: Don't be sad; Teacher Li won't criticize you.
items.why: Comforting someone with 不会 ... 的 predicts what will not happen. 不能 would be an order not to criticize, and 的 is not used with it.

items.q: 我明天一定会把书带来___。
items.zh: 我明天一定会把书带来的。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān yī dìng huì bǎ shū dài lái de
items.en: I'll definitely bring the book tomorrow.
items.why: A promise with 会 closes with 的. 了 marks a completed event and clashes with 明天, and 吗 would turn it into a question.

items.q: 别急，经理马上就___回你电话的。
items.zh: 别急，经理马上就会回你电话的。
items.py: bié jí jīng lǐ mǎ shàng jiù huì huí nǐ diàn huà de
items.en: Don't worry, the manager will call you back right away.
items.why: The 会 ... 的 frame reassures. 要 does not pair with the closing 的, and 可以 would mean the manager is allowed to call back.

items.q: 你放心，我们___让你失望的。
items.zh: 你放心，我们不会让你失望的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ men bù huì ràng nǐ shī wàng de
items.en: Rest assured, we won't let you down.
items.why: A reassurance that something will not happen is 不会 ... 的. 不能 or 不可以 would be about what is not allowed, not a promise.

items.q: 只要你认真准备，面试官一定___喜欢你的。
items.zh: 只要你认真准备，面试官一定会喜欢你的。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi miàn shì guān yī dìng huì xǐ huan nǐ de
items.en: As long as you prepare seriously, the interviewer will surely like you.
items.why: 一定会 ... 的 predicts and assures. 能 and 可以 cannot express that a feeling will arise.

items.q: 我会游泳，但是今天感冒了，不___游。
items.zh: 我会游泳，但是今天感冒了，不能游。
items.py: wǒ huì yóu yǒng dàn shì jīn tiān gǎn mào le bù néng yóu
items.en: I can swim, but I have a cold today, so I can't.
items.why: The skill is there, but today's cold blocks it, so 不能. 不会 would contradict 我会游泳.

items.q: 他会做饭，可是手受伤了，现在不___做。
items.zh: 他会做饭，可是手受伤了，现在不能做。
items.py: tā huì zuò fàn kě shì shǒu shòu shāng le xiàn zài bù néng zuò
items.en: He knows how to cook, but his hand is hurt, so he can't right now.
items.why: He has the skill but an injury stops him now: 不能. 不会 would deny the skill that the sentence grants.

items.q: 她的腿好了，已经___自己走路去上班了。
items.zh: 她的腿好了，已经能自己走路去上班了。
items.py: tā de tuǐ hǎo le yǐ jīng néng zì jǐ zǒu lù qù shàng bān le
items.en: Her leg is better; she can already walk to work by herself.
items.why: Ability regained after recovery is 能. 会 would describe learning to walk for the first time, like a baby.

items.q: 对不起，我现在在开会，不___接电话。
items.zh: 对不起，我现在在开会，不能接电话。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ xiàn zài zài kāi huì bù néng jiē diàn huà
items.en: Sorry, I'm in a meeting and can't take calls right now.
items.why: Being in a meeting is a circumstance that blocks you, so 不能. 不会接电话 would mean you never learned to answer phones.

items.q: 网络坏了，我们现在不___上网。
items.zh: 网络坏了，我们现在不能上网。
items.py: wǎng luò huài le wǒ men xiàn zài bù néng shàng wǎng
items.en: The network is down, so we can't get online now.
items.why: The broken network is the circumstance that blocks the action: 不能. 不会 would mean we don't know how to go online, and 不可以 would mean it is forbidden.

items.q: 病好了，他明天___去上班了。
items.zh: 病好了，他明天能去上班了。
items.py: bìng hǎo le tā míng tiān néng qù shàng bān le
items.en: He's recovered and can go back to work tomorrow.
items.why: Recovering from illness restores the ability to work: 能 ... 了. 会 would only predict or say he has learned something.

items.q: 图书馆今天停电了，同学们不___在里面看书。
items.zh: 图书馆今天停电了，同学们不能在里面看书。
items.py: tú shū guǎn jīn tiān tíng diàn le tóng xué men bù néng zài lǐ miàn kàn shū
items.en: The library has a power cut today, so students can't read in there.
items.why: The power cut is the circumstance that makes reading impossible: 不能. 不会看书 would mean they cannot read at all.

items.q: 他虽然会说中文，可是今天嗓子哑了，不___说话。
items.zh: 他虽然会说中文，可是今天嗓子哑了，不能说话。
items.py: tā suī rán huì shuō zhōng wén kě shì jīn tiān sǎng zi yǎ le bù néng shuō huà
items.en: Although he can speak Chinese, his voice is hoarse today and he can't speak.
items.why: 虽然会 grants the skill, and the hoarse throat blocks it today: 不能. 不会 contradicts 会说中文.

items.q: 我昨天熬夜了，今天太困，实在不___集中注意力。
items.zh: 我昨天熬夜了，今天太困，实在不能集中注意力。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān áo yè le jīn tiān tài kùn shí zài bù néng jí zhōng zhù yì lì
items.en: I stayed up late yesterday and am so sleepy that I really can't concentrate.
items.why: Tiredness is the circumstance that blocks concentration, so 不能. 不会 would mean you do not know how to concentrate.

items.q: 你的脚好点了吗？___走路了吗？
items.zh: 你的脚好点了吗？能走路了吗？
items.py: nǐ de jiǎo hǎo diǎn le ma néng zǒu lù le ma
items.en: Is your foot a bit better? Can you walk now?
items.why: Asking whether an injury still stops you is 能. 会走路了吗 asks whether someone has learned to walk, which fits a baby, not an injured foot.

items.q: 他胃口很大，一顿___吃三碗米饭。
items.zh: 他胃口很大，一顿能吃三碗米饭。
items.py: tā wèi kǒu hěn dà yī dùn néng chī sān wǎn mǐ fàn
items.en: He has a big appetite; he can eat three bowls of rice at a meal.
items.why: An amount (三碗) that a person is able to manage is 能. 会 would make it a prediction that he will eat three bowls.

items.q: 她打字很快，一分钟___打一百个字。
items.zh: 她打字很快，一分钟能打一百个字。
items.py: tā dǎ zì hěn kuài yī fēn zhōng néng dǎ yī bǎi gè zì
items.en: She types fast; she can type a hundred characters a minute.
items.why: A speed measured with a number (一百个字 per minute) is capacity, so 能. 会 only says the skill exists.

items.q: 我每天锻炼，现在___游一千米。
items.zh: 我每天锻炼，现在能游一千米。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān duàn liàn xiàn zài néng yóu yī qiān mǐ
items.en: I exercise every day; now I can swim a thousand metres.
items.why: A distance (一千米) is an amount of ability, so 能. 会 would just say I know how to swim.

items.q: 这个教室很大，___坐五十个学生。
items.zh: 这个教室很大，能坐五十个学生。
items.py: zhè ge jiào shì hěn dà néng zuò wǔ shí gè xué sheng
items.en: This classroom is big and can seat fifty students.
items.why: The capacity of a room is a number it can hold, so 能. 会坐五十个学生 would say it will seat fifty, not that it has room for them.

items.q: 他记性好，一天___背五十个生词。
items.zh: 他记性好，一天能背五十个生词。
items.py: tā jì xìng hǎo yī tiān néng bèi wǔ shí gè shēng cí
items.en: He has a good memory; he can memorize fifty new words a day.
items.why: 五十个生词 per day measures his capacity, so 能. 会 would not mean he is able to reach that amount.

items.q: 她每天都锻炼，一口气___跑五公里。
items.zh: 她每天都锻炼，一口气能跑五公里。
items.py: tā měi tiān dōu duàn liàn yī kǒu qì néng pǎo wǔ gōng lǐ
items.en: She exercises every day; she can run five kilometres in one go.
items.why: A distance reached in one breath (五公里) is capacity: 能. 会 would only say she knows how to run.

items.q: 这个软件很先进，一秒钟就___翻译上千个句子。
items.zh: 这个软件很先进，一秒钟就能翻译上千个句子。
items.py: zhè ge ruǎn jiàn hěn xiān jìn yī miǎo zhōng jiù néng fān yì shàng qiān gè jù zi
items.en: This software is advanced; it can translate thousands of sentences in a second.
items.why: Speed with a number (一秒钟 ... 上千个句子) is 能. 会 would predict that it will translate them, not describe its capacity.

items.q: 我们的电梯很大，一次___坐十五个人。
items.zh: 我们的电梯很大，一次能坐十五个人。
items.py: wǒ men de diàn tī hěn dà yī cì néng zuò shí wǔ gè rén
items.en: Our lift is big and can carry fifteen people at a time.
items.why: The number of people the lift holds is a capacity, so 能. 会 would only predict that fifteen people will sit.

items.q: 我一个小时___写五十个汉字。
items.zh: 我一个小时能写五十个汉字。
items.py: wǒ yī gè xiǎo shí néng xiě wǔ shí gè hàn zì
items.en: I can write fifty characters in an hour.
items.why: An amount in a time span (五十个汉字 per hour) is capacity: 能. 会 would say only that I can write characters.

items.q: 老师，我___进来吗？
items.zh: 老师，我可以进来吗？
items.py: lǎo shī wǒ kě yǐ jìn lái ma
items.en: Teacher, may I come in?
items.why: Asking permission is 可以 ... 吗. 会 would ask whether I will come in, and 要 would ask whether I want to.

items.q: 这儿___拍照，你拍吧。
items.zh: 这儿可以拍照，你拍吧。
items.py: zhè r kě yǐ pāi zhào nǐ pāi ba
items.en: You may take photos here; go ahead.
items.why: A place where something is permitted takes 可以. 会拍照 would say people know how to take photos.

items.q: 去公司你___坐地铁，比开车快。
items.zh: 去公司你可以坐地铁，比开车快。
items.py: qù gōng sī nǐ kě yǐ zuò dì tiě bǐ kāi chē kuài
items.en: You could take the subway to the office; it's faster than driving.
items.why: Offering an option is 可以. 会 would predict that you will take the subway.

items.q: 我___用一下你的笔吗？
items.zh: 我可以用一下你的笔吗？
items.py: wǒ kě yǐ yòng yī xià nǐ de bǐ ma
items.en: May I use your pen for a moment?
items.why: Asking permission is 可以. 会 would ask whether I will or know how to use a pen.

items.q: 学生___在图书馆借五本书。
items.zh: 学生可以在图书馆借五本书。
items.py: xué sheng kě yǐ zài tú shū guǎn jiè wǔ běn shū
items.en: Students may borrow five books from the library.
items.why: A rule about what is allowed takes 可以. 会 would be a prediction about what students will do.

items.q: 有问题你___问老师，不用不好意思。
items.zh: 有问题你可以问老师，不用不好意思。
items.py: yǒu wèn tí nǐ kě yǐ wèn lǎo shī bù yòng bù hǎo yì sī
items.en: If you have a question, you can ask the teacher; no need to be shy.
items.why: Telling someone an option is open is 可以. 得 means must, which clashes with 不用不好意思.

items.q: 今天太忙了，我们___叫外卖吃。
items.zh: 今天太忙了，我们可以叫外卖吃。
items.py: jīn tiān tài máng le wǒ men kě yǐ jiào wài mài chī
items.en: We're too busy today; we could order takeout.
items.why: Suggesting an option is 可以. 会 would predict that we will order takeout.

items.q: 如果你对这个方案有不同的意见，___在会议上提出来。
items.zh: 如果你对这个方案有不同的意见，可以在会议上提出来。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ duì zhè ge fāng àn yǒu bù tóng de yì jiàn kě yǐ zài huì yì shàng tí chū lái
items.en: If you have a different opinion about this plan, you can raise it at the meeting.
items.why: Pointing out an open option is 可以. 会 would predict that you will raise it, which is not what the sentence offers.

items.q: 你的作业如果没写完，___明天早上交给我。
items.zh: 你的作业如果没写完，可以明天早上交给我。
items.py: nǐ de zuò yè rú guǒ méi xiě wán kě yǐ míng tiān zǎo shang jiāo gěi wǒ
items.en: If you haven't finished your homework, you can hand it in to me tomorrow morning.
items.why: Granting an option is 可以. 会 would predict what you will do, not tell you what the teacher allows.

items.q: 经理，我___明天再交报告吗？
items.zh: 经理，我可以明天再交报告吗？
items.py: jīng lǐ wǒ kě yǐ míng tiān zài jiāo bào gào ma
items.en: Manager, may I hand in the report tomorrow instead?
items.why: Asking the boss for leave to do it later is permission: 可以. 会 would ask whether I will, which is not a request.

items.q: 对不起，我明天要出差，___去参加你的婚礼。
items.zh: 对不起，我明天要出差，不能去参加你的婚礼。
items.py: duì bu qǐ wǒ míng tiān yào chū chāi bù néng qù cān jiā nǐ de hūn lǐ
items.en: Sorry, I have a business trip tomorrow, so I can't come to your wedding.
items.why: 'Can't make it' because of circumstances is 不能. 不可以 would mean someone forbids you to go.

items.q: 我从来没学过，不___做饭，每天都在外面吃。
items.zh: 我从来没学过，不会做饭，每天都在外面吃。
items.py: wǒ cóng lái méi xué guò bù huì zuò fàn měi tiān dōu zài wài miàn chī
items.en: I've never learned; I can't cook, so I eat out every day.
items.why: 没学过 means no know-how: 不会. 不可以 would mean cooking is forbidden, which has nothing to do with eating out.

items.q: 我保证以后不___再迟到了。
items.zh: 我保证以后不会再迟到了。
items.py: wǒ bǎo zhèng yǐ hòu bù huì zài chí dào le
items.en: I promise I won't be late again.
items.why: 保证 introduces what will not happen, so 不会. 不可以 would mean being late is not permitted, and 不能 would say you are unable to be late.

items.q: 老师说，上课的时候___玩手机。
items.zh: 老师说，上课的时候不可以玩手机。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō shàng kè de shí hou bù kě yǐ wán shǒu jī
items.en: The teacher said you may not play on your phone during class.
items.why: A rule the teacher lays down is 不可以. 不会 would mean students don't know how to, and 不想 would give personal wishes.

items.q: 对不起，会议还没结束，你现在不___进去。
items.zh: 对不起，会议还没结束，你现在不能进去。
items.py: duì bu qǐ huì yì hái méi jié shù nǐ xiàn zài bù néng jìn qù
items.en: Sorry, the meeting isn't over, so you can't go in right now.
items.why: The unfinished meeting blocks entry, so 不能. 不会进去 would predict you will not enter.

items.q: 我可以用你的电脑吗？不___，我还要用。
items.zh: 我可以用你的电脑吗？不行，我还要用。
items.py: wǒ kě yǐ yòng nǐ de diàn nǎo ma bù xíng wǒ hái yào yòng
items.en: May I use your computer? No, I'm still using it.
items.why: The natural refusal to 可以 ... 吗 is 不行. 不会 is never an answer to a request, and 不用 means 'no need'.

items.q: 因为公司有规定，上班时间员工不___在办公室里吃饭。
items.zh: 因为公司有规定，上班时间员工不可以在办公室里吃饭。
items.py: yīn wèi gōng sī yǒu guī dìng shàng bān shí jiān yuán gōng bù kě yǐ zài bàn gōng shì lǐ chī fàn
items.en: Because of company rules, staff may not eat in the office during working hours.
items.why: A company rule is a prohibition: 不可以. 不会 would claim staff simply don't eat there.

items.q: 你不用担心，这种小病不___影响你的工作。
items.zh: 你不用担心，这种小病不会影响你的工作。
items.py: nǐ bù yòng dān xīn zhè zhǒng xiǎo bìng bù huì yǐng xiǎng nǐ de gōng zuò
items.en: Don't worry; this kind of minor illness won't affect your work.
items.why: Reassuring about what will not happen is 不会. 不能影响 would be an order that it must not affect your work.

items.q: 她很___做饭，每个人都说好吃。
items.zh: 她很会做饭，每个人都说好吃。
items.py: tā hěn huì zuò fàn měi gè rén dōu shuō hǎo chī
items.en: She's really good at cooking; everyone says it tastes good.
items.why: Skill plus 很 is 很会 + verb. 可以 cannot take 很, and 很能做饭 does not mean skilful.

items.q: 我弟弟很___吃，一顿吃五碗饭。
items.zh: 我弟弟很能吃，一顿吃五碗饭。
items.py: wǒ dì di hěn néng chī yī dùn chī wǔ wǎn fàn
items.en: My little brother can really eat; he has five bowls of rice at a meal.
items.why: Eating a lot is 很能吃. 很会吃 would mean he knows good food, and 可以 cannot take 很.

items.q: 他很___说话，同事们都喜欢他。
items.zh: 他很会说话，同事们都喜欢他。
items.py: tā hěn huì shuō huà tóng shì men dōu xǐ huan tā
items.en: He's good with words; his colleagues all like him.
items.why: Being skilful at speaking tactfully is 很会说话. 很能 points to capacity or quantity, not skill.

items.q: 这个孩子真___睡，一口气睡了十二个小时。
items.zh: 这个孩子真能睡，一口气睡了十二个小时。
items.py: zhè ge hái zi zhēn néng shuì yī kǒu qì shuì le shí èr gè xiǎo shí
items.en: This child can really sleep; he slept twelve hours straight.
items.why: Twelve hours is an amount, so 真能睡 (a large capacity). 可以 cannot follow 真.

items.q: 我们的经理特别___安排时间，所有工作都按时完成。
items.zh: 我们的经理特别会安排时间，所有工作都按时完成。
items.py: wǒ men de jīng lǐ tè bié huì ān pái shí jiān suǒ yǒu gōng zuò dōu àn shí wán chéng
items.en: Our manager is especially good at scheduling; all the work is finished on time.
items.why: Scheduling well is a skill, so 特别会. 能 would stress capacity, and 可以 does not follow 特别.

items.s: 我没学过游泳，所以我不可以游泳。
items.s_py: wǒ méi xué guò yóu yǒng suǒ yǐ wǒ bù kě yǐ yóu yǒng
items.zh: 我没学过游泳，所以我不会游泳。
items.py: wǒ méi xué guò yóu yǒng suǒ yǐ wǒ bù huì yóu yǒng
items.en: I've never learned to swim, so I can't swim.
items.why: 没学过 means no know-how, which is 不会. 不可以 means it is forbidden.

items.s: 我会开车，但是我不会开手动挡的车。
items.s_py: wǒ huì kāi chē dàn shì wǒ bù huì kāi shǒu dòng dǎng de chē
items.zh: 我会开车，但是我不会开手动挡的车。
items.py: wǒ huì kāi chē dàn shì wǒ bù huì kāi shǒu dòng dǎng de chē
items.en: I can drive, but I can't drive a manual car.
items.why: Both halves are about learned skill, so 会 and 不会 are right; the second 不会 narrows the skill and does not contradict the first.

items.s: 天气预报说，明天可以下大雨。
items.s_py: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān kě yǐ xià dà yǔ
items.zh: 天气预报说，明天会下大雨。
items.py: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān huì xià dà yǔ
items.en: The forecast says it will rain heavily tomorrow.
items.why: A forecast is a prediction, so 会. 可以 would make rain something permitted.

items.s: 你要是迟到，老师会不高兴的。
items.s_py: nǐ yào shi chí dào lǎo shī huì bù gāo xìng de
items.zh: 你要是迟到，老师会不高兴的。
items.py: nǐ yào shi chí dào lǎo shī huì bù gāo xìng de
items.en: If you're late, the teacher will be unhappy.
items.why: 会 predicts the teacher's reaction and 的 closes the sentence; 会不高兴 (will be unhappy) is a normal order, with no 不会 needed.

items.s: 吃这么多糖，你可以牙疼。
items.s_py: chī zhè me duō táng nǐ kě yǐ yá téng
items.zh: 吃这么多糖，你会牙疼。
items.py: chī zhè me duō táng nǐ huì yá téng
items.en: Eating that much sugar, you'll get a toothache.
items.why: A consequence is predicted with 会. 可以 would say you are allowed to have a toothache.

items.s: 放心，我会的给你打电话。
items.s_py: fàng xīn wǒ huì de gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.zh: 放心，我会给你打电话的。
items.py: fàng xīn wǒ huì gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de
items.en: Don't worry, I'll call you.
items.why: In 会 ... 的 the 的 closes the whole sentence; it cannot sit between 会 and the verb phrase.

items.s: 你放心，他一定会按时到的。
items.s_py: nǐ fàng xīn tā yī dìng huì àn shí dào de
items.zh: 你放心，他一定会按时到的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn tā yī dìng huì àn shí dào de
items.en: Rest assured, he will definitely arrive on time.
items.why: 一定会 ... 的 is the standard assurance: 会 for the prediction and 的 at the very end, with no 了.

items.s: 我明天会去看你了。
items.s_py: wǒ míng tiān huì qù kàn nǐ le
items.zh: 我明天会去看你的。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān huì qù kàn nǐ de
items.en: I'll come and see you tomorrow.
items.why: A future promise with 会 ends in 的. 了 marks a completed event or a new situation and cannot close a sentence about tomorrow.

items.s: 我会开车，但是今天喝酒了，不会开车。
items.s_py: wǒ huì kāi chē dàn shì jīn tiān hē jiǔ le bù huì kāi chē
items.zh: 我会开车，但是今天喝酒了，不能开车。
items.py: wǒ huì kāi chē dàn shì jīn tiān hē jiǔ le bù néng kāi chē
items.en: I can drive, but I've been drinking today, so I can't drive.
items.why: The skill is granted by 我会开车, so the second clause needs the circumstance modal 不能. 不会开车 would contradict the first clause.

items.s: 他会说法语，可是今天嗓子疼，不能说话。
items.s_py: tā huì shuō fǎ yǔ kě shì jīn tiān sǎng zi téng bù néng shuō huà
items.zh: 他会说法语，可是今天嗓子疼，不能说话。
items.py: tā huì shuō fǎ yǔ kě shì jīn tiān sǎng zi téng bù néng shuō huà
items.en: He can speak French, but his throat hurts today, so he can't talk.
items.why: Both modals are correct: 会 for the skill and 不能 for today's blocking circumstance.

items.s: 公司停电了，同事们现在不会用电脑。
items.s_py: gōng sī tíng diàn le tóng shì men xiàn zài bù huì yòng diàn nǎo
items.zh: 公司停电了，同事们现在不能用电脑。
items.py: gōng sī tíng diàn le tóng shì men xiàn zài bù néng yòng diàn nǎo
items.en: The company has a power cut, so colleagues can't use their computers right now.
items.why: A power cut is a circumstance, so 不能. 不会 would say the colleagues never learned to use computers, which a power cut cannot explain.

items.s: 我们公司的电梯一次会坐十个人。
items.s_py: wǒ men gōng sī de diàn tī yī cì huì zuò shí gè rén
items.zh: 我们公司的电梯一次能坐十个人。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī de diàn tī yī cì néng zuò shí gè rén
items.en: Our company's lift can carry ten people at a time.
items.why: A number of people the lift holds is capacity, so 能. 会 would be a prediction and is wrong for describing a lift.

items.s: 我会游泳，可是一次只能游五十米。
items.s_py: wǒ huì yóu yǒng kě shì yī cì zhǐ néng yóu wǔ shí mǐ
items.zh: 我会游泳，可是一次只能游五十米。
items.py: wǒ huì yóu yǒng kě shì yī cì zhǐ néng yóu wǔ shí mǐ
items.en: I can swim, but I can only swim fifty metres at a time.
items.why: 会 names the skill, and 能 with a distance (五十米) measures how much of it I can manage; the two do not clash.

items.s: 老师，我会出去一下吗？
items.s_py: lǎo shī wǒ huì chū qù yī xià ma
items.zh: 老师，我可以出去一下吗？
items.py: lǎo shī wǒ kě yǐ chū qù yī xià ma
items.en: Teacher, may I step out for a moment?
items.why: Asking permission needs 可以. 会 would ask whether I will go out, which is not a request.

items.s: 你可以明天再交作业。
items.s_py: nǐ kě yǐ míng tiān zài jiāo zuò yè
items.zh: 你可以明天再交作业。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ míng tiān zài jiāo zuò yè
items.en: You can hand in the homework tomorrow instead.
items.why: Granting an option or permission is 可以; 再 after 明天 just means 'only then', so there is no clash.

items.s: 我明天要加班，不可以来参加你的生日会。
items.s_py: wǒ míng tiān yào jiā bān bù kě yǐ lái cān jiā nǐ de shēng rì huì
items.zh: 我明天要加班，不能来参加你的生日会。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān yào jiā bān bù néng lái cān jiā nǐ de shēng rì huì
items.en: I have to work overtime tomorrow, so I can't come to your birthday party.
items.why: 'Can't make it' because of work is 不能. 不可以 would mean someone forbids you to come.

items.s: 这个办公室里不可以抽烟。
items.s_py: zhè ge bàn gōng shì lǐ bù kě yǐ chōu yān
items.zh: 这个办公室里不可以抽烟。
items.py: zhè ge bàn gōng shì lǐ bù kě yǐ chōu yān
items.en: Smoking is not allowed in this office.
items.why: A rule or prohibition takes 不可以. It is a correct, slightly formal alternative to 不能.

items.s: 我可以先走吗？不会，你再等一下。
items.s_py: wǒ kě yǐ xiān zǒu ma bù huì nǐ zài děng yī xià
items.zh: 我可以先走吗？不行，你再等一下。
items.py: wǒ kě yǐ xiān zǒu ma bù xíng nǐ zài děng yī xià
items.en: May I leave first? No, wait a little longer.
items.why: Refusing a request for permission takes 不行 (or 不能). 不会 predicts or denies know-how and is never an answer to 可以 ... 吗.

items.s: 他很可以说话，大家都喜欢听他讲。
items.s_py: tā hěn kě yǐ shuō huà dà jiā dōu xǐ huan tīng tā jiǎng
items.zh: 他很会说话，大家都喜欢听他讲。
items.py: tā hěn huì shuō huà dà jiā dōu xǐ huan tīng tā jiǎng
items.en: He's good with words; everyone likes listening to him.
items.why: Being skilful is 很会. 可以 cannot be modified by 很 to mean good at.

items.s: 我哥哥很能吃，一个人吃了两个蛋糕。
items.s_py: wǒ gē ge hěn néng chī yī gè rén chī le liǎng gè dàn gāo
items.zh: 我哥哥很能吃，一个人吃了两个蛋糕。
items.py: wǒ gē ge hěn néng chī yī gè rén chī le liǎng gè dàn gāo
items.en: My older brother can really eat; he ate two cakes by himself.
items.why: 很能吃 means eating a great deal, which the amount in the second clause confirms; 很会吃 would mean he knows good food.

items.zh: 我会说一点儿中文。
items.py: wǒ huì shuō yī diǎn r zhōng wén
items.en: I can speak a little Chinese.
items.why: The modal 会 goes before the verb and the object follows it. 一点儿中文 stays after 说.

items.zh: 明天下午会下大雨。
items.py: míng tiān xià wǔ huì xià dà yǔ
items.en: It will rain heavily tomorrow afternoon.
items.why: The time phrase comes first, then 会 before the verb 下. Putting 会 after 下大雨 would break the sentence.

items.zh: 经理一定会同意的。
items.py: jīng lǐ yī dìng huì tóng yì de
items.en: The manager will definitely agree.
items.why: 一定 comes before 会, and 的 closes the assurance. 的 cannot go between 会 and 同意.

items.zh: 只要你好好复习，你一定会通过的。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ hǎo hǎo fù xí nǐ yī dìng huì tōng guò de
items.en: As long as you review properly, you'll definitely pass.
items.why: The 一定会 ... 的 assurance keeps 的 last in its clause; the 只要 clause may come before or after it.

items.zh: 我今天发烧了，所以不能上班。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān fā shāo le suǒ yǐ bù néng shàng bān
items.en: I have a fever today, so I can't go to work.
items.why: The fever is the circumstance, so 不能 follows 所以. 不会 would say you never learned to work.

items.zh: 她一分钟能打一百个字。
items.py: tā yī fēn zhōng néng dǎ yī bǎi gè zì
items.en: She can type a hundred characters a minute.
items.why: The time span sits before 能, and the amount follows the verb. 能 cannot come after 打.

items.zh: 这个会议室一次能坐二十个人。
items.py: zhè ge huì yì shì yī cì néng zuò èr shí gè rén
items.en: This meeting room can seat twenty people at a time.
items.why: Capacity is measured by an amount after the verb (二十个人), with 能 before 坐; 一次 may sit before or after 能.

items.zh: 我可以坐在这儿吗？
items.py: wǒ kě yǐ zuò zài zhè r ma
items.en: May I sit here?
items.why: 可以 comes before the verb phrase, and 吗 ends the permission question.

items.zh: 学生上课时不可以玩手机。
items.py: xué sheng shàng kè shí bù kě yǐ wán shǒu jī
items.en: Students may not play on their phones during class.
items.why: 不可以 sits right before the verb phrase, in front of 玩手机. A rule laid down for students is 不可以.

items.zh: 我同事很会安排时间。
items.py: wǒ tóng shì hěn huì ān pái shí jiān
items.en: My colleague is very good at scheduling.
items.why: 很 comes before 会, which comes before the verb phrase. 很可以 would not work.

items.src_py: wǒ míng tiān gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.task: Make it a promise with 会 ... 的.
items.zh: 我明天会给你打电话的。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān huì gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de
items.en: I'll call you tomorrow.
items.why: Add 会 before the coverb phrase and put 的 at the very end; the time word may come before or after the subject.

items.src_py: nǐ kě yǐ zài zhè r chōu yān
items.task: Make it a prohibition with 不能.
items.zh: 你不能在这儿抽烟。
items.py: nǐ bù néng zài zhè r chōu yān
items.en: You can't smoke here.
items.why: Put 不能 directly before the verb phrase to say you are not allowed or able to do it. The sentence needs 不 on 能, not on the verb 抽烟.

items.src_py: tā yī dùn chī sān wǎn mǐ fàn
items.task: Say he is able to eat that much, using 能.
items.zh: 他一顿能吃三碗米饭。
items.py: tā yī dùn néng chī sān wǎn mǐ fàn
items.en: He can eat three bowls of rice at a meal.
items.why: An amount reached (三碗) is expressed with 能 before the verb. 会 would turn it into a prediction.

items.src_py: wǒ yòng yī xià nǐ de diàn nǎo
items.task: Turn it into a polite request with 可以 ... 吗.
items.zh: 我可以用一下你的电脑吗？
items.py: wǒ kě yǐ yòng yī xià nǐ de diàn nǎo ma
items.en: May I use your computer for a moment?
items.why: Asking permission puts 可以 before the verb and 吗 at the end; the object can also be fronted as a topic.

items.task: Say it will not rain tomorrow, using 不会.
items.zh: 明天不会下雨。
items.py: míng tiān bù huì xià yǔ
items.en: It won't rain tomorrow.
items.why: A prediction that something will not happen is 不会 before the verb. 不能 or 不可以 would be about ability or permission.

items.q: 奶奶从小就___包饺子，包得又快又好。
items.zh: 奶奶从小就会包饺子，包得又快又好。
items.py: nǎi nǎi cóng xiǎo jiù huì bāo jiǎo zi bāo de yòu kuài yòu hǎo
items.en: Grandma has known how to make dumplings since she was little, and she makes them quickly and well.
items.why: 从小就 plus 'quick and good' describes a skill she learned, so 会. 可以 would only say that making dumplings is allowed or is one option.

items.q: 我爸爸没学过英语，所以不___说英语。
items.zh: 我爸爸没学过英语，所以不会说英语。
items.py: wǒ bà bà méi xué guò yīng yǔ suǒ yǐ bú huì shuō yīng yǔ
items.en: My dad never studied English, so he can't speak it.
items.why: 没学过 shows the reason is never having learned, so the negative is 不会. 不可以 would mean he is forbidden to speak English, which the reason does not support.

items.q: 我妈妈___做蛋糕，生日蛋糕都是她自己做的。
items.zh: 我妈妈会做蛋糕，生日蛋糕都是她自己做的。
items.py: wǒ mā mā huì zuò dàn gāo shēng rì dàn gāo dōu shì tā zì jǐ zuò de
items.en: My mum knows how to bake cakes; all the birthday cakes are ones she made herself.
items.why: Her cakes show a skill she has, so 会. 可以 would say baking is allowed or optional and gives no reason why she is the one who bakes.

items.q: 我女儿四岁了，还不___自己系鞋带。
items.zh: 我女儿四岁了，还不会自己系鞋带。
items.py: wǒ nǚ ér sì suì le hái bú huì zì jǐ jì xié dài
items.en: My daughter is four and doesn't know how to tie her own shoelaces yet.
items.why: 还不 plus a small child points to a skill not yet learned, so 不会. 不可以 would mean someone forbids her to tie them.

items.q: 外婆不___用智能手机，每次都要我帮她发信息。
items.zh: 外婆不会用智能手机，每次都要我帮她发信息。
items.py: wài pó bú huì yòng zhì néng shǒu jī měi cì dōu yào wǒ bāng tā fā xìn xī
items.en: Grandma doesn't know how to use a smartphone; she always needs me to send messages for her.
items.why: Needing help every time shows she never learned how, so 不会. 不可以 would mean she is not allowed to use it, which makes no sense here.

items.q: 妈妈说她小时候没人教她游泳，所以到现在还不___游。
items.zh: 妈妈说她小时候没人教她游泳，所以到现在还不会游。
items.py: mā mā shuō tā xiǎo shí hòu méi rén jiào tā yóu yǒng suǒ yǐ dào xiàn zài hái bú huì yóu
items.en: Mum says nobody taught her to swim as a child, so even now she can't swim.
items.why: 没人教 means she never learned, so 不会. 不可以游 would be a ban on swimming, not a missing skill.

items.q: 我爷爷小时候没上过学，不___写字，只好请邻居帮他写信。
items.zh: 我爷爷小时候没上过学，不会写字，只好请邻居帮他写信。
items.py: wǒ yé yé xiǎo shí hòu méi shàng guò xué bú huì xiě zì zhǐ hǎo qǐng lín jū bāng tā xiě xìn
items.en: My grandpa never went to school as a child, so he can't write and has to ask a neighbour to write letters for him.
items.why: 没上过学 explains a skill he never acquired, so 不会. 不可以写字 would say he is not allowed to write, which is not the point.

items.q: 我的朋友在国外长大，从来不___用筷子，所以我们请他吃饭的时候给他拿了刀叉。
items.zh: 我的朋友在国外长大，从来不会用筷子，所以我们请他吃饭的时候给他拿了刀叉。
items.py: wǒ de péng yǒu zài guó wài zhǎng dà cóng lái bú huì yòng kuài zi suǒ yǐ wǒ men qǐng tā chī fàn de shí hòu gěi tā ná le dāo chā
items.en: My friend grew up abroad and has never known how to use chopsticks, so when we had him over for dinner we gave him a knife and fork.
items.why: Growing up abroad explains a missing skill, so 不会. 不可以 would imply chopsticks are forbidden to him, and nobody would swap them for a knife and fork for that reason.

items.q: 你看，云越来越多，一会儿一定___下雨。
items.zh: 你看，云越来越多，一会儿一定会下雨。
items.py: nǐ kàn yún yuè lái yuè duō yī huì r yí dìng huì xià yǔ
items.en: Look, the clouds are gathering; it is sure to rain in a while.
items.why: A forecast from the clouds is a prediction, so 会. 能 and 可以 talk about ability or permission, and rain cannot be allowed or able.

items.q: 别担心，这只小狗不___咬你，它很乖。
items.zh: 别担心，这只小狗不会咬你，它很乖。
items.py: bié dān xīn zhè zhǐ xiǎo gǒu bú huì yǎo nǐ tā hěn guāi
items.en: Don't worry, this puppy won't bite you; it is very well behaved.
items.why: 'It is well behaved' supports a prediction that it won't bite, so 不会. 不可以 would be a rule laid on the dog, and 不能 would say it is unable to bite.

items.q: 你不吃早饭，上课的时候___很饿。
items.zh: 你不吃早饭，上课的时候会很饿。
items.py: nǐ bù chī zǎo fàn shàng kè de shí hòu huì hěn è
items.en: If you skip breakfast, you'll be very hungry in class.
items.why: A consequence of skipping breakfast is a prediction, so 会. Hunger is not an ability or a permission, so 能 and 可以 fail.

items.q: 你不穿外套就出门，肯定___感冒。
items.zh: 你不穿外套就出门，肯定会感冒。
items.py: nǐ bù chuān wài tào jiù chū mén kěn dìng huì gǎn mào
items.en: Going out without a coat, you're sure to catch a cold.
items.why: 肯定 plus a result is a prediction, so 会. 可以 would suggest catching a cold is an allowed option, and 能 would mean you are able to catch one.

items.q: 妈妈看到你的成绩，一定___生气。
items.zh: 妈妈看到你的成绩，一定不会生气。
items.py: mā mā kàn dào nǐ de chéng jì yí dìng bú huì shēng qì
items.en: Mum surely won't be angry when she sees your grades.
items.why: Whether someone will be angry is a prediction, so 不会. 不能 or 不可以 would turn it into a ban on getting angry.

items.q: 你把牛奶放在外面，晚上就___坏。
items.zh: 你把牛奶放在外面，晚上就会坏。
items.py: nǐ bǎ niú nǎi fàng zài wài miàn wǎn shàng jiù huì huài
items.en: If you leave the milk out, it will go bad by tonight.
items.why: What will happen to the milk is a prediction, so 会. Milk spoiling is neither a skill nor a permission, so 能 and 可以 do not fit.

items.q: 孩子长得这么快，这件衣服明年就___小了。
items.zh: 孩子长得这么快，这件衣服明年就会小了。
items.py: hái zi zhǎng de zhè me kuài zhè jiàn yī fú míng nián jiù huì xiǎo le
items.en: Kids grow so fast; this piece of clothing will be too small next year.
items.why: 明年就…了 predicts a future state, so 会. 能 and 可以 would need someone able or allowed to do something, but clothes just become small.

items.q: 要是价钱一直不降，来买东西的客人就___越来越少。
items.zh: 要是价钱一直不降，来买东西的客人就会越来越少。
items.py: yào shì jià qián yì zhí bù jiàng lái mǎi dōng xī de kè rén jiù huì yuè lái yuè shǎo
items.en: If the prices never come down, fewer and fewer customers will come to shop.
items.why: 要是 … 就 sets up a predicted consequence, so 会. 能 or 可以 would suggest the customers are able or allowed to decrease.

items.q: 商店八点就关门，你九点才去，肯定___白跑一趟。
items.zh: 商店八点就关门，你九点才去，肯定会白跑一趟。
items.py: shāng diàn bā diǎn jiù guān mén nǐ jiǔ diǎn cái qù kěn dìng huì bái pǎo yī tàng
items.en: The shop closes at eight; if you only go at nine, you'll surely have made the trip for nothing.
items.why: 肯定 plus a predicted result takes 会. 能 would mean you are able to waste the trip and 可以 would make it a permission; neither predicts what will happen.

items.q: 别担心，这家店的东西不___很贵的。
items.zh: 别担心，这家店的东西不会很贵的。
items.py: bié dān xīn zhè jiā diàn de dōng xī bú huì hěn guì de
items.en: Don't worry, the things in this shop won't be very expensive.
items.why: 别担心 and a closing 的 mark a reassuring prediction, so 不会. 不能 or 不可以 would be a rule, not comfort.

items.q: 你放心，奶奶一定___喜欢这件新衣服的。
items.zh: 你放心，奶奶一定会喜欢这件新衣服的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn nǎi nǎi yí dìng huì xǐ huān zhè jiàn xīn yī fú de
items.en: Don't worry, Grandma will definitely like this new outfit.
items.why: 一定 … 的 is the assurance pattern with 会. Liking something is not an ability or a permission, so 能 and 可以 do not work.

items.q: 放心吧，我不___忘记你的生日的。
items.zh: 放心吧，我不会忘记你的生日的。
items.py: fàng xīn ba wǒ bú huì wàng jì nǐ de shēng rì de
items.en: Rest assured, I won't forget your birthday.
items.why: 放心吧 plus a closing 的 is a promise with 不会. 不能 or 不可以 would mean I am not allowed or able to forget, which is not a promise.

items.q: 你放心，店里的人不___多收你的钱的。
items.zh: 你放心，店里的人不会多收你的钱的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn diàn lǐ de rén bú huì duō shōu nǐ de qián de
items.en: Don't worry, the shop staff won't overcharge you.
items.why: 'Don't worry' makes this an assurance about what will happen, so 不会 ... 的. 不能 would read as a rule against overcharging, which is not reassurance.

items.q: 你要是把新手机弄丢了，爸爸一定不___高兴的。
items.zh: 你要是把新手机弄丢了，爸爸一定不会高兴的。
items.py: nǐ yào shì bǎ xīn shǒu jī nòng diū le bà bà yí dìng bú huì gāo xìng de
items.en: If you lose your new phone, Dad will definitely be unhappy.
items.why: A predicted reaction with 一定 and a final 的 takes 会. 不能高兴 or 不可以高兴 would mean he is forbidden to be happy.

items.q: 买这么多没用的东西，妈妈回来看到，一定___骂你的。
items.zh: 买这么多没用的东西，妈妈回来看到，一定会骂你的。
items.py: mǎi zhè me duō méi yòng de dōng xī mā mā huí lái kàn dào yí dìng huì mà nǐ de
items.en: If Mum comes back and sees you bought so many useless things, she'll definitely scold you.
items.why: This warns of a likely reaction, so 会 ... 的. 可以骂你 would mean she may scold you, as a permission, and 能 would be about her ability.

items.q: 我的腿很疼，现在不___走路。
items.zh: 我的腿很疼，现在不能走路。
items.py: wǒ de tuǐ hěn téng xiàn zài bù néng zǒu lù
items.en: My leg hurts a lot; I can't walk right now.
items.why: The pain stops me now, so 不能. 不会走路 would mean I never learned to walk.

items.q: 现在是晚上十二点，商店都关门了，我们不___买东西了。
items.zh: 现在是晚上十二点，商店都关门了，我们不能买东西了。
items.py: xiàn zài shì wǎn shàng shí èr diǎn shāng diàn dōu guān mén le wǒ men bù néng mǎi dōng xī le
items.en: It's midnight and the shops are all closed, so we can't buy anything now.
items.why: Shops being closed is the circumstance that blocks buying, so 不能. 不会买东西 would say we don't know how to buy things.

items.q: 我手机没电了，___打电话了。
items.zh: 我手机没电了，不能打电话了。
items.py: wǒ shǒu jī méi diàn le bù néng dǎ diàn huà le
items.en: My phone is dead, so I can't make calls.
items.why: No battery is the circumstance, so 不能. 不会打电话 would mean I never learned how to make a call.

items.q: 我会开车，可是今天喝了酒，所以不___开。
items.zh: 我会开车，可是今天喝了酒，所以不能开。
items.py: wǒ huì kāi chē kě shì jīn tiān hē le jiǔ suǒ yǐ bù néng kāi
items.en: I can drive, but I've been drinking today, so I can't.
items.why: The first clause says I have the skill, so only the situation (drinking) blocks me: 不能. 不会 would contradict 我会开车.

items.q: 电脑坏了，我现在不___上网。
items.zh: 电脑坏了，我现在不能上网。
items.py: diàn nǎo huài le wǒ xiàn zài bù néng shàng wǎng
items.en: The computer is broken, so I can't get online right now.
items.why: A broken computer is a circumstance, so 不能. 不会上网 would say I never learned how to go online.

items.q: 我会做饭，可是今天煤气坏了，不___做饭。
items.zh: 我会做饭，可是今天煤气坏了，不能做饭。
items.py: wǒ huì zuò fàn kě shì jīn tiān méi qì huài le bù néng zuò fàn
items.en: I can cook, but the gas is broken today, so I can't cook.
items.why: 可是 contrasts the skill with the blocking situation, so 不能. 不会做饭 would contradict the first clause.

items.q: 我的钱包不见了，我现在不___买东西。
items.zh: 我的钱包不见了，我现在不能买东西。
items.py: wǒ de qián bāo bú jiàn le wǒ xiàn zài bù néng mǎi dōng xī
items.en: My wallet is missing, so I can't buy anything right now.
items.why: With the wallet gone, buying is blocked by the situation: 不能. 不会 would say I lack the skill of shopping.

items.q: 爷爷的腿好了，已经___自己上楼了。
items.zh: 爷爷的腿好了，已经能自己上楼了。
items.py: yé yé de tuǐ hǎo le yǐ jīng néng zì jǐ shàng lóu le
items.en: Grandpa's leg has healed, and he can go upstairs by himself again.
items.why: An ability regained after getting better is 能. 会 would mean he has just learned to climb stairs, as a toddler would.

items.q: 我们昨天买的电视机坏了，所以今天不___看电视了，只好看手机。
items.zh: 我们昨天买的电视机坏了，所以今天不能看电视了，只好看手机。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān mǎi de diàn shì jī huài le suǒ yǐ jīn tiān bù néng kàn diàn shì le zhǐ hǎo kàn shǒu jī
items.en: The TV we bought yesterday broke, so we can't watch TV today and have to watch on our phones.
items.why: The broken set blocks watching, so 不能. 不会看电视 would mean we never learned to watch TV.

items.q: 客厅的灯坏了，孩子晚上想在客厅写作业也不___，只能去爸爸的房间写。
items.zh: 客厅的灯坏了，孩子晚上想在客厅写作业也不能，只能去爸爸的房间写。
items.py: kè tīng de dēng huài le hái zi wǎn shàng xiǎng zài kè tīng xiě zuò yè yě bù néng zhǐ néng qù bà bà de fáng jiān xiě
items.en: The living-room light is broken, so even if the child wants to do homework there in the evening, he can't and has to use Dad's room.
items.why: 想 ... 也不 says the wish is blocked by the broken light, a circumstance, so 不能. 不会 would say he never learned how to do homework there.

items.q: 我爸爸一顿___吃三碗米饭。
items.zh: 我爸爸一顿能吃三碗米饭。
items.py: wǒ bà bà yī dùn néng chī sān wǎn mǐ fàn
items.en: My dad can eat three bowls of rice in one meal.
items.why: The amount 三碗 measures his capacity, so 能. 会 would read as a prediction that he will eat three bowls.

items.q: 这个箱子很大，___放二十本书。
items.zh: 这个箱子很大，能放二十本书。
items.py: zhè ge xiāng zi hěn dà néng fàng èr shí běn shū
items.en: This box is big; it can hold twenty books.
items.why: A capacity with a number (二十本) is 能. 会放 would be a prediction about what someone will put in.

items.q: 这辆小汽车只___坐四个人，我们六个人坐不下。
items.zh: 这辆小汽车只能坐四个人，我们六个人坐不下。
items.py: zhè liàng xiǎo qì chē zhǐ néng zuò sì gè rén wǒ men liù gè rén zuò bù xià
items.en: This little car can only seat four people; the six of us don't fit.
items.why: 只能 plus a number gives the maximum capacity. 只会坐 would be a prediction and 只要坐 would mean 'only need to seat'.

items.q: 她一分钟___打一百个字，比我快多了。
items.zh: 她一分钟能打一百个字，比我快多了。
items.py: tā yì fēn zhōng néng dǎ yì bǎi gè zì bǐ wǒ kuài duō le
items.en: She can type a hundred characters a minute, much faster than me.
items.why: 一分钟 plus a count is a measured ability, so 能. 会 would only say she has learned to type, with no speed.

items.q: 我家的小狗很大，一次___吃两斤肉。
items.zh: 我家的小狗很大，一次能吃两斤肉。
items.py: wǒ jiā de xiǎo gǒu hěn dà yī cì néng chī liǎng jīn ròu
items.en: Our dog is big; it can eat a kilo of meat at a time.
items.why: A weight measured after the verb marks capacity, so 能. 会 would announce a future event instead.

items.q: 这家面包店的烤炉特别大，一次___烤三百个面包，所以不用等很久。
items.zh: 这家面包店的烤炉特别大，一次能烤三百个面包，所以不用等很久。
items.py: zhè jiā miàn bāo diàn de kǎo lú tè bié dà yī cì néng kǎo sān bǎi gè miàn bāo suǒ yǐ bú yòng děng hěn jiǔ
items.en: This bakery's oven is very big; it can bake three hundred loaves at a time, so there is no long wait.
items.why: 一次 plus 三百个 measures what the oven can handle, so 能. 会烤 would predict that someone will bake that many, not state capacity.

items.q: 奶奶年纪这么大了，一口气还___走五公里，身体真好。
items.zh: 奶奶年纪这么大了，一口气还能走五公里，身体真好。
items.py: nǎi nǎi nián jì zhè me dà le yī kǒu qì hái néng zǒu wǔ gōng lǐ shēn tǐ zhēn hǎo
items.en: Grandma is so old, yet she can still walk five kilometres in one go; her health is wonderful.
items.why: 一口气 plus 五公里 measures the stretch she can manage without stopping, so 能. 会 would not say she is able to manage that distance.

items.q: 这个冰箱不太大，一次最多___放二十瓶牛奶，再多就放不下了。
items.zh: 这个冰箱不太大，一次最多能放二十瓶牛奶，再多就放不下了。
items.py: zhè ge bīng xiāng bù tài dà yī cì zuì duō néng fàng èr shí píng niú nǎi zài duō jiù fàng bù xià le
items.en: This fridge isn't very big; it can hold at most twenty bottles of milk at a time, and more won't fit.
items.why: 最多 plus a number is the upper limit of capacity, so 能. 会放 would predict rather than measure.

items.q: 老师，我___用一下你的笔吗？
items.zh: 老师，我可以用一下你的笔吗？
items.py: lǎo shī wǒ kě yǐ yòng yī xià nǐ de bǐ ma
items.en: Teacher, may I use your pen for a moment?
items.why: Asking permission takes 可以. 会 would ask whether I will use it or know how to use a pen.

items.q: 妈妈，我___吃一个冰淇淋吗？
items.zh: 妈妈，我可以吃一个冰淇淋吗？
items.py: mā mā wǒ kě yǐ chī yí gè bīng qí lín ma
items.en: Mum, may I have an ice cream?
items.why: 'May I' is permission, so 可以. 会吃 would ask whether I will eat one, which is not a request.

items.q: 这家商店里___拍照，你拍吧。
items.zh: 这家商店里可以拍照，你拍吧。
items.py: zhè jiā shāng diàn lǐ kě yǐ pāi zhào nǐ pāi ba
items.en: Photos are allowed in this shop, go ahead and take one.
items.why: 你拍吧 shows the speaker is giving the go-ahead, so 可以. 会拍照 would predict that someone takes photos.

items.q: 这家商店的衣服___试穿，不满意也可以不买。
items.zh: 这家商店的衣服可以试穿，不满意也可以不买。
items.py: zhè jiā shāng diàn de yī fú kě yǐ shì chuān bù mǎn yì yě kě yǐ bù mǎi
items.en: You can try the clothes on in this shop, and you needn't buy if you're not happy.
items.why: Trying on is allowed, a shop policy, so 可以. 会试穿 would predict that someone will try them on.

items.q: 要是你觉得太贵，你___去旁边那家看看。
items.zh: 要是你觉得太贵，你可以去旁边那家看看。
items.py: yào shì nǐ jué de tài guì nǐ kě yǐ qù páng biān nà jiā kàn kàn
items.en: If you think it's too expensive, you could go and have a look at the shop next door.
items.why: This offers an option, a 'you could', so 可以. 会去 would be a flat claim that you will go.

items.q: 这个周末你要是没事，___来我家吃饭。
items.zh: 这个周末你要是没事，可以来我家吃饭。
items.py: zhè ge zhōu mò nǐ yào shì méi shì kě yǐ lái wǒ jiā chī fàn
items.en: If you're free this weekend, you can come to my place for dinner.
items.why: An invitation presents an open option, so 可以. 会来我家吃饭 would be a prediction, not an invitation.

items.q: 如果你觉得网上买东西不放心，也___先去商店看看，再决定买不买。
items.zh: 如果你觉得网上买东西不放心，也可以先去商店看看，再决定买不买。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ jué de wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xī bù fàng xīn yě kě yǐ xiān qù shāng diàn kàn kàn zài jué dìng mǎi bù mǎi
items.en: If you don't feel safe buying online, you could also go and look in a shop first and then decide.
items.why: The suggestion offers an alternative, so 可以. 会先去商店看看 would claim you will definitely do so.

items.q: 买东西的时候，如果觉得价钱太贵，你___和老板商量一下，说不定能便宜一点儿。
items.zh: 买东西的时候，如果觉得价钱太贵，你可以和老板商量一下，说不定能便宜一点儿。
items.py: mǎi dōng xī de shí hòu rú guǒ jué de jià qián tài guì nǐ kě yǐ hé lǎo bǎn shāng liáng yī xià shuō bù dìng néng pián yi yì diǎn r
items.en: When shopping, if the price seems too high, you can talk it over with the owner; it might get cheaper.
items.why: Suggesting a feasible move is 可以. 会和老板商量 would state a prediction, and the later 能 belongs to the possible outcome, not this modal.

items.q: 妈妈，我可以买这个玩具吗？——___，你已经有很多玩具了。
items.zh: 妈妈，我可以买这个玩具吗？——不行，你已经有很多玩具了。
items.py: mā mā wǒ kě yǐ mǎi zhè ge wán jù ma bù xíng nǐ yǐ jīng yǒu hěn duō wán jù le
items.en: Mum, may I buy this toy? -- No, you already have lots of toys.
items.why: The reply to a 可以...吗 request is 不行 (or 不能). 不会 is for a missing skill or a prediction and cannot refuse a request.

items.q: 我明天要去医院，所以___来上课。
items.zh: 我明天要去医院，所以不能来上课。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān yào qù yī yuàn suǒ yǐ bù néng lái shàng kè
items.en: I have to go to the hospital tomorrow, so I can't come to class.
items.why: 'Can't make it' is 不能. 不可以 would mean someone forbids me to come.

items.q: 我的钱不够，今天___买这个包了。
items.zh: 我的钱不够，今天不能买这个包了。
items.py: wǒ de qián bù gòu jīn tiān bù néng mǎi zhè ge bāo le
items.en: I don't have enough money, so I can't buy this bag today.
items.why: Not enough money is a practical block, so 不能. 不可以 would mean the purchase is prohibited.

items.q: 医院里面___大声说话，别人在休息。
items.zh: 医院里面不可以大声说话，别人在休息。
items.py: yī yuàn lǐ miàn bù kě yǐ dà shēng shuō huà bié rén zài xiū xī
items.en: You may not talk loudly inside the hospital; others are resting.
items.why: A rule for others' sake is a prohibition, so 不可以. 不会 would predict that people don't talk loudly, which is not a rule.

items.q: 我问姐姐可不可以用她的电脑，姐姐说：“对不起，现在___，我要写作业。”
items.zh: 我问姐姐可不可以用她的电脑，姐姐说：“对不起，现在不行，我要写作业。”
items.py: wǒ wèn jiě jiě kě bù kě yǐ yòng tā de diàn nǎo jiě jiě shuō duì bù qǐ xiàn zài bù xíng wǒ yào xiě zuò yè
items.en: I asked my sister if I could use her computer, and she said, "Sorry, not right now; I need to do my homework."
items.why: The polite refusal to a 可以 request is 不行. 不会 cannot refuse permission, and 不用 would mean 'no need'.

items.q: 没学过英语的人，当然___说英语。
items.zh: 没学过英语的人，当然不会说英语。
items.py: méi xué guò yīng yǔ de rén dāng rán bú huì shuō yīng yǔ
items.en: Of course someone who has never studied English can't speak it.
items.why: 没学过 shows a missing skill, so 不会. 不可以 would say speaking English is banned for them.

items.q: 你放心，这家店的老板人很好，___骗你的。
items.zh: 你放心，这家店的老板人很好，不会骗你的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn rén hěn hǎo bù huì piàn nǐ de
items.en: Don't worry, the owner of this shop is a good man; he won't cheat you.
items.why: A prediction about his behaviour is 不会 ... 的. 不可以骗你 would be a rule imposed on him rather than a statement about his character.

items.q: 妈妈说，吃饭的时候___看手机，要专心吃饭。
items.zh: 妈妈说，吃饭的时候不可以看手机，要专心吃饭。
items.py: mā mā shuō chī fàn de shí hòu bù kě yǐ kàn shǒu jī yào zhuān xīn chī fàn
items.en: Mum says you may not look at your phone while eating; you have to focus on the meal.
items.why: A family rule is 不可以. 不会看手机 would say it just doesn't happen, which does not fit 要专心.

items.q: 我问老板可不可以多拿一份，他说___，每个人只能拿一份。
items.zh: 我问老板可不可以多拿一份，他说不行，每个人只能拿一份。
items.py: wǒ wèn lǎo bǎn kě bù kě yǐ duō ná yī fèn tā shuō bù xíng měi gè rén zhǐ néng ná yī fèn
items.en: I asked the boss if I could take an extra portion, and he said no; everyone can only take one.
items.why: Answering a 可不可以 question with a refusal is 不行. 不会 cannot refuse a request.

items.q: 我妈妈很___做饭，大家都爱吃她做的菜。
items.zh: 我妈妈很会做饭，大家都爱吃她做的菜。
items.py: wǒ mā mā hěn huì zuò fàn dà jiā dōu ài chī tā zuò de cài
items.en: My mum is really good at cooking; everyone loves her food.
items.why: Everyone loving her dishes shows skill, so 很会. 很能做饭 would suggest she cooks huge amounts, and 很可以 is never used.

items.q: 我弟弟很___吃，一个人吃了一只鸡。
items.zh: 我弟弟很能吃，一个人吃了一只鸡。
items.py: wǒ dì di hěn néng chī yí gè rén chī le yī zhī jī
items.en: My little brother can really eat; he ate a whole chicken by himself.
items.why: 一只鸡 is about quantity, so 很能吃. 很会吃 would mean he knows good food, and 很可以 does not work.

items.q: 她很___买东西，同样的东西总是买得比别人便宜。
items.zh: 她很会买东西，同样的东西总是买得比别人便宜。
items.py: tā hěn huì mǎi dōng xī tóng yàng de dōng xī zǒng shì mǎi de bǐ bié rén pián yi
items.en: She is very good at shopping; she always gets the same things cheaper than others.
items.why: Always buying cheaper shows skill, so 很会. 很能买东西 would hint at buying enormous amounts, and 可以 does not take 很.

items.q: 这只小狗真___吃，一下子吃了两斤肉。
items.zh: 这只小狗真能吃，一下子吃了两斤肉。
items.py: zhè zhǐ xiǎo gǒu zhēn néng chī yī xià zi chī le liǎng jīn ròu
items.en: This puppy can really eat; it ate a kilo of meat in one go.
items.why: The point is the amount eaten, so 真能吃. 真会吃 would praise how it chooses food and does not fit the quantity.

items.q: 老板很___说话，我本来只想看看，最后还是买了两件。
items.zh: 老板很会说话，我本来只想看看，最后还是买了两件。
items.py: lǎo bǎn hěn huì shuō huà wǒ běn lái zhǐ xiǎng kàn kàn zuì hòu hái shì mǎi le liǎng jiàn
items.en: The owner is very good with words; I only meant to look but ended up buying two items.
items.why: Talking me into buying shows persuasive skill, so 很会说话. 很能说话 would not mean this, and 很可以 is not a pattern.

items.q: 他太太很___做生意，同样的东西，她总能卖得比别人贵。
items.zh: 他太太很会做生意，同样的东西，她总能卖得比别人贵。
items.py: tā tài tài hěn huì zuò shēng yì tóng yàng de dōng xī tā zǒng néng mài de bǐ bié rén guì
items.en: His wife is very good at business; she can always sell the same goods for more than others.
items.why: Selling at higher prices shows business skill, so 很会做生意. 可以 cannot follow 很, and 很能 stresses quantity, not skill.

items.q: 你这个孩子真___说，一个人说了一个小时还没停。
items.zh: 你这个孩子真能说，一个人说了一个小时还没停。
items.py: nǐ zhè ge hái zi zhēn néng shuō yí gè rén shuō le yí gè xiǎo shí hái méi tíng
items.en: You really can talk, child; you've talked for a whole hour on your own and still haven't stopped.
items.why: Talking for an hour without stopping is about quantity and stamina, so 真能说. 真会说 would praise being clever with words, not how much you talk.

items.zh: 我明天不能去商店。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān bù néng qù shāng diàn
items.en: I can't go to the shop tomorrow.
items.why: 不能 sits before the verb 去 and means unable; 明天 may come before or after the subject, but 不可以 would mean forbidden.

items.zh: 姐姐一个小时能走五公里。
items.py: jiě jiě yí gè xiǎo shí néng zǒu wǔ gōng lǐ
items.en: My older sister can walk five kilometres in an hour.
items.why: The time span precedes 能 and the amount follows the verb. Putting the amount before the verb or using 会 would not express capacity.

items.zh: 你可以用我的手机。
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ yòng wǒ de shǒu jī
items.en: You may use my phone.
items.why: 可以 comes straight before the verb 用 to grant permission; 我的手机 stays together as the object.

items.zh: 明天会下大雨。
items.py: míng tiān huì xià dà yǔ
items.en: It will rain heavily tomorrow.
items.why: The time word opens the sentence, then 会 before the verb for the prediction; there is no subject for the weather.

items.zh: 他很会做生意。
items.py: tā hěn huì zuò shēng yì
items.en: He is very good at business.
items.why: 很会 is the skill pattern placed right before the verb phrase 做生意; 很 cannot be split from 会.

items.zh: 放心吧，我一定会来接你的。
items.py: fàng xīn ba wǒ yí dìng huì lái jiē nǐ de
items.en: Rest assured, I will definitely come and pick you up.
items.why: 一定 and 会 sit before the verb phrase and 的 closes the sentence; 的 directly after 会 is the classic error.

items.zh: 这儿不可以大声说话。
items.py: zhè r bù kě yǐ dà shēng shuō huà
items.en: You may not talk loudly here.
items.why: 不可以 comes before the verb phrase to state a ban, and 大声 stays in front of 说话. 这儿 as topic opens the rule.

items.zh: 因为感冒了，我不能去接孩子。
items.py: yīn wèi gǎn mào le wǒ bù néng qù jiē hái zi
items.en: Because I have a cold, I can't go and pick up the kid.
items.why: The reason clause may open the sentence or follow 我, but 不能 must stay directly before 去接孩子; 不会 would say I never learned to.

items.zh: 奶奶不会用手机。
items.py: nǎi nǎi bú huì yòng shǒu jī
items.en: Grandma doesn't know how to use a phone.
items.why: 不会 comes before the verb 用 and says the skill was never learned; 不可以 would be a ban.

items.zh: 这家店的老板很会和客人聊天。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn hěn huì hé kè rén liáo tiān
items.en: The owner of this shop is very good at chatting with customers.
items.why: 很会 stays before the coverb phrase 和客人 and the verb 聊天; the whole skill phrase follows the subject 老板.

items.src_py: wǒ men zài zhè r pāi zhào
items.task: Ask politely if it is allowed (use 可以 and 吗).
items.zh: 我们可以在这儿拍照吗？
items.py: wǒ men kě yǐ zài zhè r pāi zhào ma
items.en: May we take photos here?
items.why: Permission question: 可以 goes before the verb phrase and 吗 closes the question. 会 would ask whether we will take photos, not whether it is allowed.

items.src_py: dì di chī le sì wǎn fàn
items.task: Say he can eat four bowls of rice in one meal (use 能).
items.zh: 弟弟一顿能吃四碗饭。
items.py: dì di yī dùn néng chī sì wǎn fàn
items.en: My little brother can eat four bowls of rice in one meal.
items.why: Capacity measured by an amount takes 能, and 了 is dropped because this is not a finished event. 会 would only predict.

items.src_py: wǒ jīn tiān qù shàng bān
items.task: Say you can't, because you are ill (use 不能 and 生病了).
items.zh: 我生病了，今天不能去上班。
items.py: wǒ shēng bìng le jīn tiān bù néng qù shàng bān
items.en: I'm ill, so I can't go to work today.
items.why: Illness is a circumstance, so 不能 right before the verb phrase. 不会 would mean I never learned to go to work, and 不可以 would mean I am forbidden.

items.task: Say he is really good at it (add 很).
items.zh: 他很会做饭。
items.py: tā hěn huì zuò fàn
items.en: He is really good at cooking.
items.why: 很 attaches directly to 会 to express skilfulness; the verb phrase follows. 很可以 would not work.

items.src_py: nǐ bù qù tā hěn nán guò
items.task: Make it a prediction with 如果 and 会.
items.zh: 如果你不去，她会很难过。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ bù qù tā huì hěn nán guò
items.en: If you don't go, she will be very upset.
items.why: 如果 sets up the condition and 会 marks the prediction of her reaction; without 会 it would just state a fact.

items.s: 我女儿没会做饭。
items.s_py: wǒ nǚ ér méi huì zuò fàn
items.zh: 我女儿不会做饭。
items.py: wǒ nǚ ér bú huì zuò fàn
items.en: My daughter doesn't know how to cook.
items.why: The skill modal 会 is negated with 不, never 没; 没会 is not Chinese.

items.s: 明天可以下大雨，你带伞吧。
items.s_py: míng tiān kě yǐ xià dà yǔ nǐ dài sǎn ba
items.zh: 明天会下大雨，你带伞吧。
items.py: míng tiān huì xià dà yǔ nǐ dài sǎn ba
items.en: It will rain heavily tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
items.why: A weather forecast is a prediction, so 会. 可以 is permission or an option and cannot predict rain.

items.s: 你不穿外套，一会儿就会冷。
items.zh: 你不穿外套，一会儿就会冷。
items.py: nǐ bù chuān wài tào yī huì r jiù huì lěng
items.en: If you don't wear a coat, you'll soon be cold.
items.why: 会 is right: this predicts a result, and 会 can sit before an adjective like 冷. It does not need a verb.

items.s: 放心，爸爸会的来接你。
items.s_py: fàng xīn bà bà huì de lái jiē nǐ
items.zh: 放心，爸爸会来接你的。
items.py: fàng xīn bà bà huì lái jiē nǐ de
items.en: Rest assured, Dad will come and pick you up.
items.why: In the assurance pattern 的 must close the sentence; placing it right after 会 breaks the pattern.

items.s: 你放心，我一定会把钱还给你的。
items.zh: 你放心，我一定会把钱还给你的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ yí dìng huì bǎ qián huán gěi nǐ de
items.en: Don't worry, I will definitely pay you the money back.
items.why: This looks tricky because of 把, but 会 ... 的 wraps the whole 把 clause correctly and 的 stays at the end.

items.s: 我明天要上班，不能会去你家玩。
items.s_py: wǒ míng tiān yào shàng bān bù néng huì qù nǐ jiā wán
items.zh: 我明天要上班，不能去你家玩。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān yào shàng bān bù néng qù nǐ jiā wán
items.en: I have to work tomorrow, so I can't come to your place.
items.why: Two modals cannot be stacked; the work schedule is the circumstance, so 不能 alone.

items.s: 我会游泳，可是今天太冷，不能下水。
items.zh: 我会游泳，可是今天太冷，不能下水。
items.py: wǒ huì yóu yǒng kě shì jīn tiān tài lěng bù néng xià shuǐ
items.en: I can swim, but it's too cold today, so I can't get in.
items.why: Correct: 会 states the skill and 不能 states the circumstance that blocks it. Using 不会 in the second clause would contradict the first.

items.s: 我能会游一千米。
items.s_py: wǒ néng huì yóu yī qiān mǐ
items.zh: 我能游一千米。
items.py: wǒ néng yóu yī qiān mǐ
items.en: I can swim a thousand metres.
items.why: Two modals cannot be stacked here; the amount 一千米 already selects 能 alone.

items.s: 我女儿才三岁，一口气能数到一百。
items.zh: 我女儿才三岁，一口气能数到一百。
items.py: wǒ nǚ ér cái sān suì yì kǒu qì néng shù dào yì bǎi
items.en: My daughter is only three, yet she can count to a hundred in one breath.
items.why: 能 is correct because the amount reached (到一百) measures her capacity, and 才三岁 only adds surprise.

items.s: 妈妈，我会看一会儿电视吗？
items.s_py: mā mā wǒ huì kàn yī huì r diàn shì ma
items.zh: 妈妈，我可以看一会儿电视吗？
items.py: mā mā wǒ kě yǐ kàn yī huì r diàn shì ma
items.en: Mum, may I watch TV for a bit?
items.why: Asking permission needs 可以 (or 能). 会 would ask whether I will watch, not whether I am allowed.

items.s: 这儿不能拍照，但是你可以在外面拍。
items.zh: 这儿不能拍照，但是你可以在外面拍。
items.py: zhè r bù néng pāi zhào dàn shì nǐ kě yǐ zài wài miàn pāi
items.en: Photos aren't allowed here, but you can take them outside.
items.why: Correct: 不能 states the rule and 可以 offers the alternative. The two modals do not clash because they belong to different clauses.

items.s: 我可以坐这儿吗？不会，这儿有人。
items.s_py: wǒ kě yǐ zuò zhè r ma bú huì zhè r yǒu rén
items.zh: 我可以坐这儿吗？不行，这儿有人。
items.py: wǒ kě yǐ zuò zhè r ma bù xíng zhè r yǒu rén
items.en: May I sit here? No, someone is sitting here.
items.why: The refusal to a permission question is 不行 or 不能. 不会 is for missing skills or predictions and cannot answer 可以...吗.

items.s: 我不会开车，所以今天不能送你。
items.zh: 我不会开车，所以今天不能送你。
items.py: wǒ bú huì kāi chē suǒ yǐ jīn tiān bù néng sòng nǐ
items.en: I don't know how to drive, so I can't take you today.
items.why: Correct: 不会 gives the missing skill and 不能 gives the resulting impossibility; the two negatives belong together.

items.s: 我妈妈很可以做饭。
items.s_py: wǒ mā mā hěn kě yǐ zuò fàn
items.zh: 我妈妈很会做饭。
items.py: wǒ mā mā hěn huì zuò fàn
items.en: My mum is very good at cooking.
items.why: 'Good at' is 很会. 可以 is permission or an option and cannot take 很 in this meaning.

items.s: 我爸爸很能睡，一睡就是十个小时。
items.zh: 我爸爸很能睡，一睡就是十个小时。
items.py: wǒ bà bà hěn néng shuì yī shuì jiù shì shí gè xiǎo shí
items.en: My dad can really sleep; once he's asleep it's ten hours.
items.why: Correct: 很能 + verb means a large capacity, and the ten hours confirm it. 很会睡 would sound like skill at sleeping.

items.s: 别担心，明天不可以下雨。
items.s_py: bié dān xīn míng tiān bù kě yǐ xià yǔ
items.zh: 别担心，明天不会下雨。
items.py: bié dān xīn míng tiān bú huì xià yǔ
items.en: Don't worry, it won't rain tomorrow.
items.why: A forecast that it won't rain is 不会. 不可以 would mean rain is forbidden, which is not a weather statement.

items.s: 这个小孩太小了，不可以自己去商店买东西，让妈妈陪他。
items.zh: 这个小孩太小了，不可以自己去商店买东西，让妈妈陪他。
items.py: zhè ge xiǎo hái tài xiǎo le bù kě yǐ zì jǐ qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xī ràng mā mā péi tā
items.en: This child is too small to go to the shop alone; let his mum go with him.
items.why: Correct: the rule against going alone is a prohibition, so 不可以 is right. It looks suspicious but is a permission issue.

items.s: 你放心，奶奶会的喜欢这个礼物。
items.s_py: nǐ fàng xīn nǎi nǎi huì de xǐ huān zhè ge lǐ wù
items.zh: 你放心，奶奶会喜欢这个礼物的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn nǎi nǎi huì xǐ huān zhè ge lǐ wù de
items.en: Don't worry, Grandma will like this gift.
items.why: The 的 of reassurance goes at the very end of the clause; inserting it right after 会 is a classic error.

items.s: 天气预报说，下午会有雨，你出门别忘了带伞。
items.zh: 天气预报说，下午会有雨，你出门别忘了带伞。
items.py: tiān qì yù bào shuō xià wǔ huì yǒu yǔ nǐ chū mén bié wàng le dài sǎn
items.en: The forecast says there will be rain this afternoon, so don't forget your umbrella when you go out.
items.why: Correct: 会有雨 predicts rain, and 会 is also fine before 有. 可以有雨 would be wrong.

items.s: 我们这个周末要带孩子去考试，不能去看奶奶。
items.zh: 我们这个周末要带孩子去考试，不能去看奶奶。
items.py: wǒ men zhè ge zhōu mò yào dài hái zi qù kǎo shì bù néng qù kàn nǎi nǎi
items.en: We have to take the child to an exam this weekend, so we can't visit Grandma.
items.why: Correct: the exam is a practical obstacle, so 不能 is exactly right. 不会 would turn it into a prediction.

items.q: 奶奶没学过用手机，所以不___用。
items.zh: 奶奶没学过用手机，所以不会用。
items.py: nǎi nǎi méi xué guò yòng shǒu jī suǒ yǐ bù huì yòng
items.en: Grandma has never learned to use a phone, so she can't use one.
items.why: 没学过 gives the reason as never having learned, so the negative of know-how is 不会. 不可以 would say she is forbidden to use it, which the reason does not support.

items.q: 冬天我们去滑冰，可是我没学过，不___滑。
items.zh: 冬天我们去滑冰，可是我没学过，不会滑。
items.py: dōng tiān wǒ men qù huá bīng kě shì wǒ méi xué guò bù huì huá
items.en: We go skating in winter, but I have never learned, so I can't skate.
items.why: 没学过 shows the skill is missing, so 不会. 不可以滑 would mean skating is not allowed, which has nothing to do with never having learned.

items.q: 弟弟从小在海边长大，很小就___游泳。
items.zh: 弟弟从小在海边长大，很小就会游泳。
items.py: dì di cóng xiǎo zài hǎi biān zhǎng dà hěn xiǎo jiù huì yóu yǒng
items.en: My younger brother grew up by the sea and could swim from a very young age.
items.why: 从小 and 很小就 point to a skill learned early, which is 会. 可以 would say he was permitted or had the option to swim, not that he knew how.

items.q: 我没学过法语，一句也不___说。
items.zh: 我没学过法语，一句也不会说。
items.py: wǒ méi xué guò fǎ yǔ yī jù yě bù huì shuō
items.en: I have never studied French; I can't say a single sentence.
items.why: 没学过 says the skill was never learned, so 不会. 不可以 would say that speaking French is forbidden, which the reason does not support.

items.q: 她学过按摩，所以___按肩膀，按得很舒服。
items.zh: 她学过按摩，所以会按肩膀，按得很舒服。
items.py: tā xué guò àn mó suǒ yǐ huì àn jiān bǎng àn de hěn shū fu
items.en: She has studied massage, so she knows how to massage shoulders, and it feels very comfortable.
items.why: 学过 marks a learned skill, so 会. 可以 would offer an option or permission and ignore the fact that her ability comes from training.

items.q: 明天___下雪，你多穿一件衣服。
items.zh: 明天会下雪，你多穿一件衣服。
items.py: míng tiān huì xià xuě nǐ duō chuān yī jiàn yī fu
items.en: It will snow tomorrow, so put on an extra layer.
items.why: 明天 plus a weather event is a prediction, so 会. 可以下雪 would give snow permission, which makes no sense.

items.q: 天气预报说，周末___下大雨。
items.zh: 天气预报说，周末会下大雨。
items.py: tiān qì yù bào shuō zhōu mò huì xià dà yǔ
items.en: The forecast says it will pour this weekend.
items.why: A forecast reports what will happen, which is 会. 可以 means allowed or an open option, and rain is neither.

items.q: 夏天太热了，不戴帽子，你___头疼。
items.zh: 夏天太热了，不戴帽子，你会头疼。
items.py: xià tiān tài rè le bù dài mào zi nǐ huì tóu téng
items.en: It is so hot in summer; without a hat you will get a headache.
items.why: The first clause is the cause and the second its likely result, a prediction, so 会. 可以头疼 would grant permission to have a headache.

items.q: 别怕，打针一点儿也不___疼。
items.zh: 别怕，打针一点儿也不会疼。
items.py: bié pà dǎ zhēn yī diǎn r yě bù huì téng
items.en: Don't be scared; the injection won't hurt at all.
items.why: Reassuring someone about what will happen takes 会 / 不会. 不能疼 would mean it is not possible or not allowed for it to hurt, as if pain were a rule.

items.q: 如果你每天睡得太少，身体就___生病。
items.zh: 如果你每天睡得太少，身体就会生病。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ měi tiān shuì de tài shǎo shēn tǐ jiù huì shēng bìng
items.en: If you sleep too little every day, you will get sick.
items.why: 如果 sets a condition and the second clause is its predicted result, so 会. 可以 would make getting sick something permitted.

items.q: 春天一到，天气就___慢慢变暖。
items.zh: 春天一到，天气就会慢慢变暖。
items.py: chūn tiān yī dào tiān qì jiù huì màn màn biàn nuǎn
items.en: Once spring arrives, the weather will gradually warm up.
items.why: Saying what the weather will do as the season turns is a prediction, so 会. 可以 cannot predict.

items.q: 医生说，只要你按时吃药，过几天感冒就___好。
items.zh: 医生说，只要你按时吃药，过几天感冒就会好。
items.py: yī shēng shuō zhǐ yào nǐ àn shí chī yào guò jǐ tiān gǎn mào jiù huì hǎo
items.en: The doctor says that if you take your medicine on time, the cold will clear up in a few days.
items.why: 只要...就 gives a condition and a predicted outcome, so 会好. 可以好 would turn getting better into something permitted.

items.q: 你放心，这个药吃了不___想睡觉。
items.zh: 你放心，这个药吃了不会想睡觉。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn zhè ge yào chī le bù huì xiǎng shuì jiào
items.en: Don't worry; this medicine won't make you sleepy.
items.why: Telling someone what will not happen is 不会. 不可以想睡觉 would say that feeling sleepy is forbidden.

items.q: 你放心，我不___忘记吃药的。
items.zh: 你放心，我不会忘记吃药的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ bù huì wàng jì chī yào de
items.en: Don't worry, I won't forget to take my medicine.
items.why: 放心 plus the closing 的 is the reassurance pattern 会 ... 的. 不能忘记 would say 'I must not forget', a rule rather than a promise.

items.q: 别担心，明天天气一定___好的。
items.zh: 别担心，明天天气一定会好的。
items.py: bié dān xīn míng tiān tiān qì yī dìng huì hǎo de
items.en: Don't worry, the weather will definitely be fine tomorrow.
items.why: 一定 ... 的 reassures about what will happen, which is 会. 可以 would suggest the weather is allowed to be good.

items.q: 别担心，我一定会按时回家___。
items.zh: 别担心，我一定会按时回家的。
items.py: bié dān xīn wǒ yī dìng huì àn shí huí jiā de
items.en: Don't worry, I will definitely be home on time.
items.why: A promise about the future is closed with 的 after 会. 了 reports a completed event or a change, which clashes with a promise, and 着 does not fit at all.

items.q: 你放心，我绝对不___把你的病告诉别人的。
items.zh: 你放心，我绝对不会把你的病告诉别人的。
items.py: nǐ fàng xīn wǒ jué duì bù huì bǎ nǐ de bìng gào sù bié rén de
